Materials for sessions 5 and 6 of the AI block: what an agent is and how it works in code, and how to make a model answer from your own documents. Everything is in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/albertotb/curso-agentes-ia).

| Session | Topic | |
|---|---|---|
| 5 · Thursday | **Tools and agents**: tool calling, the agent loop, good tools, security, MCP, frameworks | [Open slides](slides/sesion5/sesion5.html) |
| 5 · Friday | **Retrieval-augmented generation**: keyword and semantic search, embeddings, chunking, answers with citations | [Open slides](slides/sesion5/sesion5_rag.html) |

## Session 6

Group project: each group builds an agent for a banking or regulatory use case and presents it to a panel. Materials will be published here.
